newsitem.title: bangladesh: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Total classified loans increased by Tk 1,100 crore in 1996, much of which have been attributed to the credits given by the state-owned commercial banks, according to a provisional statistics by the central bank.
The next round of peace talks between the goverment and tribal Shanti Bahini rebels will resume on May 11 in Dhaka.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Sunday criticised her main political rival and opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia for seeking removal of the Chief Election Commissioner.
Alberto Fujimoro, President of Peru, will arrive in Dhaka on May 24 on a day's visit to Bangladesh.

Police and paramilitary BDR forces, in a midnight swoop on Sunday, arrested 125 students from student dormitories of Rajshahi university and off-campus houses, for their alleged involvement in the ransacking of university offices on Saturday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Sunday declared that a sound national population policy would be enunciated soon keeping in view the socio-economic condition of the country.
Bangladesh and Kuwait have agreed to keep their manpower agents under strict supervision to stop exploitation of workers.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Sunday called upon the people to remain "alert" and "resist" any attempt to jeopardise country's economic development, peace and stability. REUTER
